title: What if Naruto joined the Akatsuki?
assumptions: Fan-created alternate timeline set during the Shippuden era while Naruto hosts the Nine Tails; not a canon summary or official release.
Assume a temporary alliance is offered despite Akatsuki's conflicting objective. Deal, missions, demands and choices are invented for this scenario.
Channel ownership and final handle remain unverified. This internal channel label is not a YouTube channel ID.

sources.supports: Akatsuki seeks the tailed beasts; the Leaf opposes its actions.
sources.access_status: Read official overview through web source; no episode footage or images copied.

sources.supports: Kurama, the Nine Tails, was sealed inside Naruto.
sources.access_status: Read official database entry; only the historical premise is used, not later Boruto outcomes.

scenes.label: THE WRONG SIDE OF THE STORY
scenes.text: What if Naruto joined the Akatsuki? The first surprise is that joining would not make him safe.

scenes.label: THE RECRUIT IS ALSO THE TARGET
scenes.text: He carries the Nine Tails, and the Akatsuki wants the tailed beasts. Their new recruit is also their target.

scenes.label: ONE DANGEROUS DEAL
scenes.text: In this alternate timeline, Naruto offers a deal: his help, in exchange for protecting his friends.

scenes.label: TRUST COMES WITH A PRICE
scenes.text: At first, the missions give him the respect he always wanted. But every favor comes with a price.

scenes.label: THEN COMES THE DEMAND
scenes.text: The breaking point arrives when his new allies demand that he turn against the Hidden Leaf.

scenes.label: HE REFUSES
scenes.text: He refuses. Now both sides question his loyalty, and the deal that protected his friends falls apart.

scenes.label: CHOOSE A SIDE
scenes.text: Naruto has to choose: prove himself to the organization, or protect the people who still believe in him.

scenes.label: WHO CHANGES WHOM?
scenes.text: Could he change the Akatsuki from inside? Or would joining them change Naruto first?
